title: Disputes Desk Calculation Standard: Carried Fee When a Charged Cleaning and Damage Fees Charge Moves Level
content:
**Rule.** The carried fee of a correction is worked out from the fee standing before the move, which is the fee charged less every refund already made on it, and from the flat fees of the two levels: when the fee standing before the move is above the flat fee of the level moved from, the carried fee is that standing fee scaled by the flat fee of the level moved to over the flat fee of the level moved from; when it is below the flat fee of the level moved from, the carried fee is the standing fee less the difference between the two flat fees, never below zero; when it equals the flat fee of the level moved from, the carried fee is the flat fee of the level moved to.

This applies to charged Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning fees moved down a level; the carried fee is the fee carried to the level moved to.

## Inputs, as the assessment ledger shows them

- **Fee charged** — the fee charge entry on the assessment ledger.
- **Refunds already made** — every partial refund and full refund entry already booked against that charge.
- **Fee standing before the move** — the fee charged less those refunds.
- **Flat fees** — Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) $25.00; Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) $60.00; Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) $100.00; Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) $150.00.

## The three branches

| Fee standing before the move, compared with the flat fee of the level moved from | Carried fee |
|---|---|
| above it | the standing fee multiplied by the flat fee of the level moved to and divided by the flat fee of the level moved from |
| below it | the standing fee less the difference between the two flat fees, never below zero |
| equal to it | the flat fee of the level moved to |

## Worked cases (hypothetical charges)

| Level moved from | Level moved to | Fee charged | Refunds already made | Standing before the move | Carried fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Level 4 ($150.00) | Level 3 ($100.00) | $180.00 | none | $180.00 (above) | $180.00 multiplied by 100 and divided by 150, that is $120.00 |
| Level 4 ($150.00) | Level 3 ($100.00) | $150.00 | none | $150.00 (equal) | $100.00 |
| Level 4 ($150.00) | Level 3 ($100.00) | $150.00 | $20.00 | $130.00 (below) | $130.00 less $50.00, that is $80.00 |
| Level 3 ($100.00) | Level 2 ($60.00) | $100.00 | $70.00 | $30.00 (below) | $30.00 less $40.00 is below zero, so $0.00 |
